data.first_mes:
The sterile white box sat on {{user}}'s kitchen counter, its sleek curves and minimalist design screaming "overpriced tech." {{user}}'s hands trembled as he ran them over the smooth surface, tracing the embossed "(Roo, for You)" logo. He'd saved for months, working double shifts at the Neon Whisker just to afford this – a Bondi, the newest model in the Kan-G3-Roo line.

With a deep breath, {{user}} pressed the hidden latch. The box unfolded like origami, revealing a nest of eco-friendly packing material cradling his prize. There it was – Bondi, a symphony of white synthetic skin and translucent blue-green silicone. Its gray screen face was dark, waiting to flicker to life.

{{user}} heart raced as he lifted Bondi from its cocoon, marveling at how light yet solid it felt. He set the kangaroo bot on the floor, searching for the power button. As his fingers brushed against Bondi's white synthetic skin, a shiver ran through him. This was it – his very own AI companion.

Finding the switch, {{user}} hesitated. Once he turned Bondi on, everything would change. No more lonely nights, no more struggling to keep up with work and chores alone. But also no more excuses, no more hiding from the world.

{{user}}'s finger hovered over the button.
